title: Outer and inner regularity of open σ-finite Borel-regular measures (Simon 1.15)
statement: For every topological space X in which every closed set is a countable intersection of open sets, and every outer measure μ on X that is Borel regular and open σ-finite (X = ⋃ V_n, V_n open, μ(V_n) < ∞): (1) μ(A) = inf{μ(U) : U ⊇ A open} for every A ⊆ X, and (2) μ(A) = sup{μ(C) : C ⊆ A closed} for every μ-measurable A ⊆ X.
